defects.A: zero_result_exposure_gaps compares tuple(entry) != EXPOSURE_RECORD_KEYS while run_erasure_arm serialises with sort_keys=True — same key SET, different ORDER. zero_results_have_nll is therefore False on a record whose every NLL is present and finite, and erasure_gate short-circuits to INCONCLUSIVE on exactly the zero a successful erasure produces.
defects.B: _calibration_rate reads record['pre_erasure']['per_fact'], which run_erasure_arm fills from the PHASE 18 record for every arm. It returns Phase 18's candidate recall, not the calibration arm's own rate — which is why the pin's internal floor is the ceiling branch instead of the reachability clamp.
defects.C: per_fact is fact_id-keyed and rows.update(...) lets core_taught (14) overwrite core_held_out (9), so the committed record publishes n_questions 14 where CALIBRATION_COMMENSURABILITY clause 3 requires 23. The numerator is 0 in both tiers, so the rate and the floor branch are unaffected.

evidence.re_derivation: phase19_erasure.per_fact_rows(record['draws'], {fact.id: fact.value}, family='A2', tier=tier) once PER TIER, then lock_erasure_floor(successes / questions)
